cohort: The study included 61,226 primiparous women, comprising 6435 adolescent mothers (younger than 20 years old) and adult mothers.
finding: Adolescent primiparous women had a 1.6 times higher age-specific PPD rate (6.1% vs. 3.8%) and a higher prevalence of PPD-associated maternal risk factors compared to adult primiparous women.
